questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a strong professional network.
options: I didn't realize the importance of networking until after I graduated.
It wasn't until I'd completed my studies that I understood the significance of networking.
It was only when I'd finished university that I appreciated the value of building relationships in my field.
The realization about the importance of networking came to me once I had finished college.
questions.answer: It wasn't until I'd completed my studies that I understood the significance of networking.

questions.question: Although she had been warned about the dangers of smoking, it was only after her sister developed lung cancer that she finally quit.
options: Her sister's illness made her realize the risks associated with smoking.
It wasn't until her sister got ill that she understood the harm caused by cigarettes.
She stopped smoking as soon as she learned about the health risks.
Her sister's condition prompted her to give up smoking.
questions.answer: It wasn't until her sister got ill that she understood the harm caused by cigarettes.

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the conference, the keynote speaker had already begun his presentation.
options: The main speaker was still setting up when I arrived.
I managed to catch the beginning of the keynote speech.
It wasn't until I'd taken my seat that the presenter started speaking.
The keynote address was well underway by the time I got there.
questions.answer: It wasn't until I'd taken my seat that the presenter started speaking.

questions.question: Had I known about the traffic jam, I would have left earlier to avoid being stuck in it.
options: If I had been aware of the congestion, I would have set off sooner.
Knowing about the traffic, I would have departed later to minimize delays.
I would have left even earlier if I'd anticipated the traffic.
Being aware of the jam, I would have stayed at home.
questions.answer: If I had been aware of the congestion, I would have set off sooner.

questions.question: It is essential that students be given the opportunity to develop their critical thinking skills through hands-on projects.
options: Students should have the chance to practice their critical thinking.
It's crucial for students to engage in practical exercises.
Hands-on activities allow students to improve their analytical abilities.
For students to think critically, they need real-world experiences.
questions.answer: Students should have the chance to practice their critical thinking.
